许默粗喘着气，扒开狼王血肉模糊的胸腔，从中掏出一颗还在微微搏动的硕大心脏。

心脏表面布满了神秘的蓝色纹路，散发着诱人的异香。

【银鬃狼王心脏（蓝色）。】

【用途：极品魔药材料，可用于制作高阶力量药剂。】

“别浪费！收狼血！”

方芸赶紧动手，省着一会儿狼血就凝固了。

两人忙完，天近乎黑了。

许默一边撕咬烤狼肉，一边望向外面。

居高临下，老枪的身影终于出现！

他一路小跑，身体早已到达极限。

身后，黑色的影子不断追逐。

老枪一刻都不敢停留，爬着石柱终于迈入营地，进入石洞之中！

“我去！差点就回不来了！”

许默此时低头看面板。

【天黑倒计时：39分钟】

确实是险之又险，不过幸好，还是回来了。

老枪气喘吁吁，许默给他递过来一块狼肉，他吃了一口，问到。

“我看外面有血迹，什么情况啊？”

许默无奈到。

“刚到家，就被一群畜生偷袭了，打了一架！”

老枪让他赶紧说说。

许默便将刚才杀了狼王的情况简单说了一下。

最后问道。

“你呢，你今天收成如何？”

老枪摆摆手。

“别提了，老子好像让那个阿三上身了，又被几条蜥蜴给追了！”

“木材，现在还差6个呢！”

许默微微点头。

“六个，够了，明早你再采一些，足够修缮营地了！”

老枪算了算，确实是这个道理。

一下子心情美丽起来，烤肉都多吃了一块。

晚上睡得更香了。

许默看着对面床上的方芸，陷入了沉思，又想到刚一切入大群界面，信息如瀑布般疯狂滚动。

恐慌的情绪溢出屏幕。

“草！这鬼地方活见鬼了！昨晚我扎营的河滩没了，一睁眼老子被架在半山腰上！”

“不是雾！是地皮自己在挪！我跟邻居本来隔着五百米，现在再问他，足足有五十公里！”

许默刷了一会，没什么营养。

正想着要不早点睡了。

他阴沉着脸切回交易界面，余光瞥见左上角不知何时多出了一个闪烁的钱袋子图标。

【流浪商人（限时）】。

许默点开标签，一个空荡荡的商品栏弹了出来，下方缀着一行极具诱惑力的小字。

【刷新商品：消耗十点幸存值】。

Xu Mo panted heavily, opened the Wolf King's bloody chest, and took out a huge heart that was still beating slightly.

The surface of the heart is covered with mysterious blue lines, exuding an alluring fragrance.

[Silver Maned Wolf King Heart (Blue).】

[Use: Top quality potion material, can be used to make high-level strength potions.】

"Don't waste it! Collect the wolf's blood!"

Fang Yun quickly took action, saving a moment for the wolf's blood to solidify.

After the two of them finished their work, it was almost dark.

Xu Mo looked outside while biting into the roasted wolf meat.

Condescendingly, the figure of Lao Qiang finally appeared!

He jogged all the way, his body already reaching its limit.

Behind him, black shadows kept chasing him.

Lao Qiang didn't dare to stay for a moment, climbed the stone pillars and finally entered the camp and entered the stone cave!

"I'm going! I almost won't be able to come back!"

Xu Mo looked down at the panel at this time.

[Countdown to dark: 39 minutes]

It was indeed a dangerous situation, but fortunately, I came back.

Lao Qiang was panting. Xu Mo handed him a piece of wolf meat. He took a bite and asked.

"I see there is blood outside, what's going on?"

Xu Mo was helpless.

"As soon as I got home, I was attacked by a group of beasts and had a fight!"

Lao Qiang asked him to talk quickly.

Xu Mo briefly explained the situation of killing the Wolf King just now.

asked finally.

"What about you, how was your harvest today?"

Lao Qiang waved his hand.

"Don't mention it, I seem to have let that Ah San get on top of me, and I'm being chased by a few lizards!"

"Timber, there are still 6 left!"

Xu Mo nodded slightly.

"Six, that's enough. You can pick some more tomorrow morning, enough to repair the camp!"

Lao Qiang has calculated it, and this is indeed the truth.

I felt so good all of a sudden that I even ate an extra piece of barbecue.

Sleep better at night.

Xu Mo looked at Fang Yun on the bed opposite and fell into deep thought. He also thought about the messages that had just entered the large group interface and were scrolling like a waterfall.

Panic overflowed the screen.

"Fuck! This damn place is so damned! The river beach where I camped last night was gone, and when I opened my eyes, I was propped up halfway up the mountain!"

"It's not the fog! It's the land that's moving on its own! My neighbor and I used to be five hundred meters apart, but now if I ask him, it's a full fifty kilometers away!"

Xu Mo brushed it for a while, but it didn't have much nutrition.

I was thinking about going to bed early.

He switched back to the trading interface with a sullen expression, and from the corner of his eye he caught a flashing money bag icon in the upper left corner.

[Wandering Merchant (Limited Time)].

Xu Mo clicked on the tab, and an empty product column popped up, with a line of very tempting small words underneath.

[Refresh the product: consume ten survival points].
